Event Rules for Participants:
* The Event Staff are recognized as: **“Aura 2YR | CC” “Aura 2YR | ES” “Aura 2YR | EA” “Aura 2YR | Lead” “Aura 2YR | Co-Lead” “Aura 2YR | Tail” “Aura 2YR | Co-Tail” “Aura 2YR | Media” “Aura 2YR | GM” “Aura 2YR | Support”** or similar.
* Free roaming on the server is prohibited.
* Participants must haul a trailer.
* Double trailers, Triple trailers, HCT trailers and Heavy Haul configurations are prohibited. (Except Event Staff)
* Participants should park at their designated slots. If you don't have a designated slot you are required to park in the 'Public Parking' area.
* Advertising is prohibited. (Except Event Organization / Event Staff)
* Overtaking is prohibited.
* Cars are prohibited except for event staff showing a clear tag.
* Participants are allowed to block the parking lane and the left lane at the start and break for a smooth starting and resume. The lane between them must be kept clear for participants who wish to drive to their VTC, petrol station or to leave the convoy. According to this image: https://imgur.com/oRAwvAy.png
All other TruckersMP rules apply.

Event Rules for Event Staff:
* Event Staff can block junctions and roads approaching junctions in order to direct the convoy.
* Event Staff can park out of bounds. Providing this is on the ground and not on top of buildings or other inappropriate places deemed unsuitable by TruckersMP Staff.
* Event Staff overtaking the convoy cannot be performed by more than 2 members at a time.
* Event Staff can drive the incorrect way where roads have a central reservation barrier ONLY. In accordance with the rule above.
All other TruckersMP rules apply.

Event Rules for Participants:
* The Event Staff are recognized as "Vanguard | F, Vanguard | PL, Vanguard | PM, Vanguard | SCCM, Vanguard | CCM, Vanguard | CCS, Vanguard | CCA, Vanguard | EM, Vanguard | ST, Vanguard | ET" or similar.
* Impersonating Event Staff using the aforementioned is forbidden.
* Instructions given by Event Staff must be followed.
* Participants must tow a trailer. ( Event staff and media personnel excluded )
* Double trailers, Triple trailers, HCT trailers and Heavy Haul configurations are prohibited. (Except Event Staff)
* Except for event staff and media personnel, vehicles and buses are prohibited from entering.
* Advertising is prohibited. (Except Event Staff)
* Overtaking is prohibited while driving. (Except for event staff and media personnel)
* Participants with consistent lag must remain at the back of the convoy.
* Participants should park at their designated slots. If you don't have a designated slot you are required to park in the 'Public Parking' area.
* Convoy participants must only leave the starting location when instructed to do so in an orderly (one by one) manner.
* Participants are allowed to block the parking lane and the left lane at the start and break for a smooth starting and resume. The lane between them must be kept clear for participants who wish to drive to their VTC, petrol station or to leave the convoy.
* All other TruckersMP rules apply.

Event Rules for Event Staff:
* Event Staff overtaking the convoy cannot be performed by more than 2 members at a time.
* Event Staff can drive the incorrect way where roads have a central reservation barrier ONLY. In accordance with the rule above.
* Event Staff can block junctions and roads approaching junctions in order to direct the convoy.
* Event Staff can park out of bounds. Providing this is on the ground and not on top of buildings or other inappropriate places deemed unsuitable by TruckersMP Staff.
* All other TruckersMP rules apply.

event_request.info:
# **Welcome to TruckersFM's 11th Anniversary Festival! 🎉**
To celebrate TruckersFM turning 11 years old, we're throwing a one-of-a-kind party! Over the weekend, there will be loads to get involved with both in-game, and on-air.  
Want to come and join the celebrations? Dial in the radio to TruckersFM and come join us at our festival!

![TFM11 Festival Map](https://i.ibb.co/yFNvVcvG/tfm11-festival.jpg)

> **Server opens:** 17:00 BST  
**Festival starts:** 18:00 BST  
**Festival ends:** 23:00 BST  
**Location:** TruckersFM 11 City (located near London, UK)

---

At the festival, why not come and get involved with all of our events? There might even be prizes to be won!

## Bash the Bin
**Time:** 18:00 - 20:00 BST  
**Prize(s):** TBC  
Ever played TMP's "Knock the cone"? This is our twist on it! In front of you is a drag strip, with 3 bins lined up in a triangle at the end. The aim of the game is to bash the front bin (marked by the first of the two white lines) WITHOUT bashing the rear two bins (marked by the second of the two white lines). If you bash the rear bins (or cross the second line), you're out! The first to bash the first bin but not the second is the winner!  
![](https://i.ibb.co/RkhpLQj5/eut2-hq-6ac554ee.jpg)

## Off-road track
**Time:** 19:00 - 22:00 BST  
**Prize(s):** TBC  
Are you feeling adventurous? Why not take on the off-road track challenge! In this event, you'll be timed around our specially made off-road course, located in the TFM11 Quarry. There will be many challenges, on this course which will test the limits of your driving skills! You'll want to make a quicksave before taking part, as vehicle damage is guaranteed! How quickly can you get round the course?  
![](https://i.ibb.co/KpH3Tp6D/eut2-hq-6ac557ef.jpg)

## Race Track
**Time:** 20:00 - 23:00 BST  
**Prize(s):** TBC  
The ultimate test of speed! Bring out your fastest truck and race other players on our all new race track! Filled with exciting corners, straights, and lots of space for showing off your speed, the race track will crown the quickest drivers of the night! Be careful though, it's easy to flip a truck if you're cornering too fast!  
![](https://i.ibb.co/ZR4CpZV3/eut2-hq-6ac55888.jpg)

---

And there's so much more fun we haven't mentioned, such as the main stage where you can come and vibe with our staff & partners at TruckersMP! We can't wait to see you there, celebrating 11 Years of broadcasting!

## **[Why not also check out the #TFM11 Convoy?](https://truckersmp.com/events/35194)**
